name: 타락한 리치
mode: built-in image generation + sprite gutter edit
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production premium dark fantasy painted 2.5D Unity monster atlas. Square 2x2 sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR complete independent full-body poses of the SAME monster, each centered in its own quadrant. Real alpha transparency. NO text, labels, dividers, floor, cast shadows or background. Orthographic 3/4 camera slightly overhead, facing screen right, consistent body scale, matching local feet baseline. Top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left attack strike, bottom-right walk. ALL body, weapons, hair stay central 65% of EACH quadrant with at least 60px transparent gutters around center divisions and outer edges. Highly detailed hand-painted materials, readable silhouette, colored shadows and restrained luminous edge light, no plastic toys, no chibi. Subject: corrupted ancient lich sorcerer, slim skeletal ivory face under tall ornate bronze crown, ragged deep midnight violet robe with antique gold embroidery, compact bone staff with a small cyan crystal held close to the body, icy cyan eyes and fingertips. Long narrow elegant silhouette, painted silk folds, intricate metal crown, restrained spectral lighting. Feet visible beneath robe, no floating smoke clouds.
edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Sprite atlas correction only. Keep this EXACT same painted lich design, robes, crown, staff and FOUR poses. Shrink each complete creature AND its staff to 60% of its own quadrant width AND height and CENTER in each quadrant, equal body scale and matching local feet baseline. Preserve 2x2 layout, real transparent alpha, no extra text or background. Minimum 80px completely transparent gutter on ALL edges of each 640px quadrant. Bottom-left staff and cyan light must stay fully inside bottom-left quadrant, never cross central vertical division. Keep quality and detail. No extra figures.
